details.title: W3 Thursday sub-LT2 reduced from 4x12 to 3x12
details.summary: Prescription vs execution: planned 4x12 sub-LT2 intervals at 88-92% LT2 power; completed all four with final-interval power fading 11% below target. Subjective: RPE 8.5, heavy legs from the first interval, poor sleep the night before. Stream analysis: aerobic_decoupling 6.8% (amber); interval_execution_quality CV 4.2% (green). Signal interactions: amber decoupling and RPE 8.5 contradict push-zone TSB (+7); green execution quality rules out a pacing error, pointing to cumulative fatigue. Approved adaptation: next sub-LT2 session reduced from 4x12 to 3x12.

subjective_inputs.sensations: heavy legs early, HR drift on final intervals

details.approved_rationale: Cumulative fatigue is higher than block average; preserving freshness outweighs hitting volume with a harder session on week 3 Thursday.
